ext_description.message: Captures the current tab's audio and finds the track in the krump library.

err_empty.message: Nothing was recorded. Check that the tab is playing sound.

err_undecodable.message: Couldn't read the recording. Please try again.

err_silent.message: Almost no sound was recorded. Check that the tab or video isn't muted or paused.

err_no_albums.message: The server has no album list.

err_no_connection.message: Can't reach the server. Try again in a moment.

err_record_start.message: Couldn't start recording. Please try again.

err_not_recording.message: No recording in progress. Please start again.

policy_change_1.message: Recordings can now be up to 1 minute.

policy_change_2.message: Tracks found are shown to others watching the same video.

library_hint.message: Browse the albums in the library

consent_sub.message: To find tracks, please agree to the following.

consent_1.message: When you search, the tab's audio (up to 1 min), its title and URL are sent to the server.

consent_2.message: Opening the popup on a video sends the video's id to look up tracks others found there. This lookup isn't stored.

consent_3.message: Tracks found are shown to others watching the same video, never the recording, the tab title or who searched.

consent_4.message: Recordings are stored on the server to improve accuracy and are never sold. No name, email or account is collected.

idle_sub.message: Listens to this tab and finds the track in the krump library.

idle_hint.message: Listens up to $1 and stops once it's sure

idle_hint_close.message: Keeps listening if you close the popup

video_verified.message: Another user found this in this video and confirmed it.

video_found.message: Another user found this in this video.

searching_sub.message: Running a last search on everything heard.

listening_sub.message: Stops as soon as it's sure.

tip_loud.message: Try again where the music is loud.

tip_longer.message: If the MC or crowd is loud, listen longer: 45 s or 1 min.

tip_missing.message: The track may not be in the library.

retry_length_group.message: Max recording length for the retry

unsure_note.message: Not sure. Check with the preview that it's the same track.

artist_only.message: This album has no store page, so this links to the artist.

answer_failed.message: Couldn't record it. Try again in a moment.

artist_page_title.message: The artist's page on $1 (no store page for the album)

loading_list.message: Loading from the server… (about 10 s if it was asleep)
